last.verdict: Pfizer raised 2026 guidance on new-product growth, but flat third-quarter revenue shows COVID declines and weaker Prevnar sales are still a drag.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rose $1.5B at the midpoint to $62-64B. Adjusted EPS outlook rose to $2.95-$3.05 from $2.80-$3.00, even after a roughly $0.10 one-time licensing charge.

takeaways.label: Newer drugs carry growth
takeaways.text: Launched and acquired products grew 32%, and revenue excluding COVID products grew 7%. Padcev rose 55% and Lorbrena 43%. Total revenue was flat at $16.6B.

takeaways.label: Eliquis boost is price-driven
takeaways.text: Eliquis sales rose 25%, up $513M. Pfizer credits mostly higher US net price from lower rebates and channel mix, not just demand.

takeaways.label: COVID and Prevnar shrinking
takeaways.text: Paxlovid fell 63% and Comirnaty 29%. Prevnar fell 10% on lower vaccination rates and lost adult market share, offsetting much of the gains elsewhere.

history.verdict: Earnings beat and a higher revenue outlook gave shares a modest lift.

reasons.label: Beat on profit
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $0.77 beat the roughly $0.68 analysts expected; revenue was $15.0B.

reasons.label: Revenue outlook raised
reasons.text: Full-year revenue guidance rose $500M at the midpoint, to $60.5-$62.5B.

reasons.label: COVID sales shrinking
reasons.text: COVID product sales forecast cut to about $4B from $5B, capping enthusiasm.
